item.title: Super Micro reports preliminary Q1 revenues of $18.5B to $19.5B, vs. $15B est., and gross margins of 12% to 12.5%; SMCI jumps 11%+ after hours (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Dina Bass / Bloomberg:
Super Micro reports preliminary Q1 revenues of $18.5B to $19.5B, vs. $15B est., and gross margins of 12% to 12.5%; SMCI jumps 11%+ after hours  —  Super Micro Computer Inc. jumped in late trading after reporting preliminary quarterly results that topped analysts' estimates.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/super-micro-jumps-after-preliminary-results-top-estimates

item.title: SpaceX reports Q3 capex of $19.6B, up from $6.9B a year earlier, and Q3 connectivity revenue, which includes Starlink, up 69% YoY to $5.2B (Becky Peterson/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Becky Peterson / Wall Street Journal:
SpaceX reports Q3 capex of $19.6B, up from $6.9B a year earlier, and Q3 connectivity revenue, which includes Starlink, up 69% YoY to $5.2B  —  Artificial intelligence revenue surges around 830% while capital spending on data center build-out and developing new technology continues

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/business/earnings/spacex-spcx-q3-earnings-report-2026-stock-4138193d?st=eQFqUL&reflink=desktopwebshare_permalink

item.title: Netflix says it expects FY 2026 ad revenue of ~$2.7B, under its ~$3B forecast, and its Q4 operating margin will be impacted due to costs associated with layoffs (Todd Spangler/Variety)
item.description:

item.title: Sources: Elon Musk ordered Starshield slowdown in Ukraine and discussed it with Trump after the issue became public; some US officials say he acted unilaterally (Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Wall Street Journal:
Sources: Elon Musk ordered Starshield slowdown in Ukraine and discussed it with Trump after the issue became public; some US officials say he acted unilaterally  —  The SpaceX founder authorized the move and has been discussing Ukraine with Trump, but the president has denied ordering the restrictions

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/world/ukraine-starlink-elon-musk-trump-dbc49193?st=SfFvsh&reflink=desktopwebshare_permalink

item.title: SpaceX reports Q3 revenue up 161% YoY to $14.58B, vs. $12.72B est., AI revenue up 830% to $7.56B, and AI operating income of $431M, up from a loss of $1.7B (Lora Kolodny/CNBC)
item.description:
Lora Kolodny / CNBC:
SpaceX reports Q3 revenue up 161% YoY to $14.58B, vs. $12.72B est., AI revenue up 830% to $7.56B, and AI operating income of $431M, up from a loss of $1.7B  —  SpaceX reported 161% revenue growth for the third quarter, driven by the company's artificial intelligence business and Starlink Subscriber growth.

Original (direct link): https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/20/spacex-spcx-earnings-live-updates-q3-2026html.html

item.title: Anthropic's IPO prospectus: H1 2026 revenue of $16.3B, ~20% from two customers, vs. $1.1B in H1 2025, and an $80.7B net loss driven by accounting charges (Anissa Gardizy/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:

Anthropic's IPO prospectus: H1 2026 revenue of $16.3B, ~20% from two customers, vs. $1.1B in H1 2025, and an $80.7B net loss driven by accounting charges  —  In a new draft prospectus viewed by the Journal, the AI giant disclosed an $80.7 billion net loss for the first half of 2026 and a long list of risk factors

item.title: Google launches TorchTPU, an open-source version of PyTorch to let AI apps run on TPUs and Google Cloud via simple configuration changes without rewriting code (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Julie Bort / TechCrunch:
Google launches TorchTPU, an open-source version of PyTorch to let AI apps run on TPUs and Google Cloud via simple configuration changes without rewriting code  —  On Tuesday, Google announced that TorchTPU, its long-awaited version of PyTorch, is now available as an open-source project.

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/google-has-joined-amazon-in-attacking-nvidias-stronghold-with-ai-app-developers/

item.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio, which builds AI agents for managing drug development, and plans to integrate its tech into OpenAI life sciences suite Rosalind (Madison Mills/Axios)
